reviews.classification: historical finite-horizon reconciliation; preserve exact scope and supersession
reviews.disposition: The launch prompt explicitly distinguishes 1,072 research metadata rows from mandatory mechanics, while requiring substantive transferable variants beyond highlighted packets to be considered. Stable provenance/applicability/owner/consumer/evidence/dependency/gate states prevent both invented scope and silent collapse. Prior Foundation closure and 139 affected or later 108/14 checks bind old finite assignments, not this adoption chain. Missing private locators are not proof of global deletion or permission for reacquisition. Its preferred agreed-duty seed is conditional, not a second funded obligation by dialogue alone; useful cause-dependent continuation requires durable history, fresh agreement, actual participant means and real consequence. Ink owns prose/continuation, native contracts own rewards and stock. AD51 now qualifies any old second-use condition: one useful shared seam can justify placement; future integration does not require speculative framework or forced consumers. Its ordinary ChatGPT reviews, delegation and successor loop are historical execution scope, not instructions to run during this reconciliation.
